correctness.rationale: The explicit independent-set partition gives the exact integer Walsh formula. Shell-counting gives nullity, rank, and spectral gap. Fourier inverse of the zero shell gives the range-idempotent convolution kernel, and translating/averaging any projection shows that this idempotent realizes the global L1 and Linfinity minimum. Exact Krawtchouk generating functions and Jensen/triangle inequalities yield the finite sum and Theta(2^(n/2)/sqrt(n)) growth. The integer checker independently verifies all 21,824 frequencies for n=3..7 and the projection kernel at n=3 and 5. Finite checks are not infinite proofs.

value.rationale: The endpoint projection constant of a natural Fourier convolution range is a meaningful operator invariant. Along odd n, its relative Fourier nullity shrinks like n^(-1/2), yet its minimum L1/Linfinity projection norm grows like 2^(n/2)/sqrt(n). The exact normalized projection kernel and sharp bound demonstrate a structural discrepancy between nearly full rank and poor endpoint complementability, not merely a renamed independence count.
